author: (C.J.Bird & E.C.Oliveira) Fredericq & Hommersand, 1989

note.en: A slender, cylindrical, Gracilaria-like red seaweed. Known from herbarium specimens from Portete near Limón.
note.es: Un alga roja delgada y cilíndrica parecida a Gracilaria. Se conoce por especímenes de herbario de Portete, cerca de Limón.

evidence: GBIF: 1 herbarium specimen record in the region

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón
